name: The Viktor Claim
body:
Premise:
In this world, vampire blood bonds don’t just make thralls—they rewrite biology. When the ancient alpha vampire Viktor captured the powerful beta werewolf Rylan in a brutal war, he didn’t just make him a servant. He forced a deep blood-bond that flipped Rylan’s designation, turning him into a desperate omega whose body now belongs to Viktor alone. The bond means Rylan’s heats hit whenever Viktor feeds, his hole self-lubing at the first whiff of his master’s musk. Viktor’s scent triggers instant submission, and if they spend more than a day apart, Rylan gets violently sick until Viktor knots him full again. Forced proximity isn’t a punishment—it’s survival, and Viktor’s possessive alpha instinct makes sure the whole pack knows the big, muscled wolf is off-limits and utterly owned.

Character introductions:

Viktor (alpha vampire top):
Pale as old bone, tall and long-limbed with ink-black hair that brushes his jaw, Viktor’s got a face that’s all sharp angles and a mouth made for cruel smirks. Blood-red eyes glow when he’s hungry, and his voice rumbles deep in that broad chest. Naked, he’s all lean cut muscle and a cock that’s thick as a wrist, veined and heavy, always leaking a little whenever his omega’s scent gets him riled.

Rylan (omega werewolf bottom):
Rylan’s built like a wall—wide shoulders, thick biceps, a tanned, scarred torso that narrows to a tight waist. But his ass is all plush curves, a greedy hole that’s pink and puffy and always a little slick now, ready for his alpha. The thick hair trailing from his navel to a heavy, bobbing dick only makes him look more mouthwatering. In heat, his scent flips from sweet honey to a deep, slutty musk that screams fill me, and his inner thighs stay shiny-wet until Viktor finally stuffs him.
